title: A permutation of a regular sequence on a finite module over a Noetherian local ring is regular
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (a Noetherian commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$). Let $M$ be a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $x_1,\dots,x_c\in R$ an $M$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Then for every permutation $\sigma$ of $\{1,\dots,c\}$ the sequence $x_{\sigma(1)},\dots,x_{\sigma(c)}$ is an $M$-regular sequence as well.
